summary.intent: Determine whether a suitable ML inference runtime exists for running a CNN on a Raspberry Pi Zero W (ARMv6), then bring CLAUDE.md and README.md up to date with the project's current state (CNN pipeline, noise pools, model experiments).
summary.outcome: Confirmed no off-the-shelf inference runtime supports ARMv6/Python 3.11 on the Pi Zero W, validating the existing plan to use a pure-numpy forward pass; then rewrote CLAUDE.md and README.md to reflect the current CNN pipeline, noise pool fetch stages, model experiment results, and updated test count, and pushed the changes to the cnn-spectrogram branch.

repo: Project doorbell-detector uses a DVC pipeline with stages including fetch_noise_esc50 and fetch_noise_demand feeding into train_cnn.py, which has replaced/supplemented XGBoost as the current train_model entrypoint
augmentation.external_noise_pools config feeds both data augmentation and background balancing using ESC-50/DEMAND noise pools
Model branch comparison results: yamnet-features 0.9956 > cnn-mfcc 0.9913 > cnn-spectrogram 0.9826 > xgboost-mfcc 0.9519
Test suite currently has 61 passing tests (was stale at 44 in CLAUDE.md)
.planning/STATE.md only reflects the v1.0 milestone; ML pipeline work since then has been tracked via ad-hoc docs/superpowers/ plans instead of the formal GSD workflow
Target Pi Zero W runs Python 3.11.2 on armv6l, Raspbian 12 Bookworm (verified via ssh)
workflow: Before trusting an existing planning doc's technical assumption (e.g., 'no ARMv6 runtime exists'), verify it against current ecosystem state via web search rather than accepting it at face value
When updating documentation, cross-check actual repo state (dvc.yaml, params.yaml, test runs, branch list) rather than relying on stale docs like README/CLAUDE.md
SSH into target hardware to confirm actual runtime environment (Python version, OS, architecture) before making deployment recommendations

friction: Official prebuilt wheels for TFLite runtime and TFLite Micro on Pi Zero are built for Python 3.7 (cp37), incompatible with the Pi's actual Python 3.11 — would require redoing the cross-compile toolchain
ONNX Runtime officially does not support Pi 1/Zero (armv6l) at all
ncnn has no armv6l Python wheels and its performance benefits rely on NEON, which the Pi Zero's ARMv6 core lacks
README.md was found to be stale (still described MFCC-only/XGBoost-only pipeline) and required a separate follow-up request to fix
open_items: TFLite Micro (via CMSIS-NN, ~8x speedup measured by driedler) remains a fallback option worth revisiting only if the pure-numpy benchmark (Task 3 of the CNN-on-Pi plan) proves too slow, but would require rebuilding the cp37 wheel for cp311
Numpy-based CNN forward pass benchmark on the actual Pi Zero W still needs to be run to confirm latency is acceptable
GSD workflow / .planning/STATE.md is out of date relative to actual ML pipeline progress and may need reconciling
